vo: For most of modern history, the biggest gains in a company's life happened behind a closed door.
Before the bell. Before the ticker. Before the public ever got a seat at the table.
By the time a company finally lists, much of its growth story has already been written. And the people who wrote it were paid in full.
Today, the world's most ambitious companies stay private longer than ever. A decade. Sometimes more.
Rocket companies. Frontier AI labs. Whole new kinds of markets. Built, scaled, and valued, almost entirely out of public view.
Meanwhile, the value they create compounds, quietly, where most people simply can't reach.
And getting access comes with conditions. Minimum tickets in the hundreds of thousands of dollars.
Accredited investors only. Lockups that last for years. Settlement measured in months, not seconds.
The door wasn't locked by accident. It was built that way.
So what happens when the door becomes a ledger?
Tessera. Pre-IPO exposure, rebuilt on-chain.
Not a promise. A structure. Here is how it works.
It starts with capital. Stablecoin liquidity, in U S D C, is deployed into a dedicated Cayman Islands segregated portfolio company.
Each portfolio is ring-fenced. Assets are held separately, series by series, with signing authority secured in multi-party Fireblocks vaults.
Then the tokens are minted on Solana, using the Token twenty twenty-two standard. Chainlink Proof of Reserve oracles verify that circulating supply matches what the custodian actually holds.
And when a liquidity event arrives, an IPO or an acquisition, the loan participation settles, and redemption opens.
What you hold is a T-Token. Loan participation rights, linked to the companies defining the next decade.
And all of it is verifiable. Reserve data is published on-chain, continuously. Not in a quarterly PDF.
Secondary pools trade around the clock on Meteora and Jupiter. Anyone can see the price. Anyone can check the reserve.
Every position can be modeled in the open. Entry, exit, and the twenty basis point transfer fee. All of it, on the table.
Every mint address is public. Every transfer is on the record.
So compare the old way, to the new one.

p.text: THE OLD WAY. THE NEW ONE.

vo: Six-figure minimums, or fractional units. Accredited only, or open secondary access. Years of lockup, or markets that never close. Ninety days to settle, or sub-second finality.
This isn't the end of private markets.

p.text: NOT THE END OF PRIVATE MARKETS.

vo: It's the moment they finally meet the public.
Tessera. Private markets. Public ledger.
